# DP-900 Practice Section 1

[![Open in Quiz Player](https://img.shields.io/badge/Open_in-Quiz_Player-blue?style=for-the-badge&logo=data:image/svg+xml;base64,)](https://quizplay.io/quiz.html?source=quizplay-io/quiz-player-quizzes-dp-900-question-set-1)

![Preview](assets/images/preview_dp900.svg)

Practice questions for the **Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900)** certification exam. This set covers core data concepts such as structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data, transactional versus analytical workloads, relational data services in the Azure SQL family and open-source database offerings, non-relational storage with Azure Blob Storage, Azure Files, Table storage, and Azure Cosmos DB, and analytics workloads with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, and Power BI.

## Content Overview

- **36 Questions** — 12 case-study questions across 4 fictional scenarios plus 24 standalone questions, using single choice, multiple choice, ordering, and matching formats
- **Topics**:
  - Describe core data concepts (25–30%)
  - Identify considerations for relational data on Azure (20–25%)
  - Describe considerations for working with non-relational data on Azure (15–20%)
  - Describe an analytics workload on Azure (25–30%)

## What This Does Not Cover

This question set focuses on **foundational data concepts and Azure data services**. It does not cover hands-on portal navigation, T-SQL programming beyond basic statement categories, database administration procedures, or deep-dive data engineering design. It is not a substitute for official Microsoft Learn training paths.

## Disclaimer

> [!IMPORTANT]
> These questions are **AI-generated** for study and practice purposes. They are **not** exam dumps and do not contain actual questions from the Microsoft certification exam. Use them to test your understanding of Azure data concepts, not as a substitute for official study materials.
